title: JFarwell Sip & Sail aboard the Reverie
blurb: This private day sail allows you to enjoy happy hour on your own time! Enjoy 1.5 hours of unwinding in luxury with friends, family or colleagues. Step aboard our 50’ Catamaran and be greeted with a perfect locally crafted beverage you pre-select with our crew. We’ll set the tone for a fun sail so everyone can immediately start to relax and explore Halifax’s premiere sailing yacht! Our Captain will discuss the best wind conditions and recommend your perfect route so you can enjoy the rush of the water under the nets as we sail through Halifax Harbour. Cheers!
